item.title: Democratic Rep. Gluesenkamp Perez and Trump-backed Republican advance in Washington primary
item.description: Democratic Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez and Republican state Sen. John Braun will advance to a general election in Washington's 3rd District, one of the most hotly contested House contests of this year, CBS News projects.

item.title: Rick Brattin wins Republican primary for Missouri seat redrawn to favor GOP
item.description: Trump-endorsed Rick Brattin won the GOP primary for Missouri's 5th Congressional District, CBS News projects, setting up a battle against an 11-term Democrat in a district that was made far more GOP-leaning.

item.title: John James wins Michigan Republican gubernatorial primary, CBS News projects
item.description: U.S. Rep. John James, endorsed by President Trump, is projected to be the winner of Tuesday's Republican gubernatorial primary race in Michigan, according to CBS News.

item.title: Progress made in Strait of Hormuz talks, Rubio says
item.description: The secretary of state said progress has been made in the Iran-Oman talks but that no final agreement has been reached, adding, "We're hoping that ‌will happen very ‌shortly."

item.title: Senate Judiciary Committee advances Blanche's nomination for attorney general
item.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee voted along party lines to advance Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general.

item.title: Benson wins Michigan Democratic gubernatorial primary, CBS News projects
item.description: Michigan Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson is projected to be the winner of Tuesday's Democratic gubernatorial primary race, according to CBS News.

item.title: What to know about primaries in 5 states today: Michigan, Virginia and more
item.description: Voters are deciding primary races Tuesday in five states: Michigan, Virginia, Missouri, Kansas and Washington.

item.title: Man carrying ammunition arrested near Trump National Golf Club before president's visit
item.description: Federal authorities arrested a man who appeared to be monitoring security-planning activities at Trump National Golf Club in LA County ahead of the president's Southern California visit.

item.title: Michigan's Democratic Senate race comes to a head as multiple states hold primaries | Special Report
item.description: Michigan, Missouri, Virginia, Kansas and Washington all held primaries Tuesday night, with much of the nation focusing on the Michigan Democratic Senate primary between Abdul El-Sayed and Rep. Haley Stevens. Major Garrett anchored CBS News' special report.

item.title: Eaton Fire in Altadena sparked by SoCal Edison electric tower, probe finds
item.description: The department said an 18-month investigation concluded that electrical arcing on an out-of-service Southern California Edison tower was responsible.

item.title: Rep. Debbie Dingell says Michigan Democratic Senate primary is "gonna be tighter than people think"
item.description: Polls have closed in Michigan, where the heated Democratic Senate contest between Abdul El-Sayed and Haley Stevens is coming to a head. Democratic Rep. Debbie Dingell of Michigan joins CBS News to weigh in.

item.title: SpaceX shows strong growth in its first earnings report since IPO
item.description: Elon Musk's rocket, satellite and AI provider reported quarterly revenue of $7.8 billion, topping Wall Street forecasts.

item.title: Wesley Bell beats Cori Bush in Missouri Democratic House primary rematch
item.description: Rep. Wesley Bell on Tuesday beat former congresswoman Cori Bush in a heated primary in Missouri's 1st Congressional District, CBS News projects.

item.title: Kind Wisconsin stranger helps rock band make it to their tour stop after car breaks down
item.description: A kind stranger named Ernie helped rock band The Autumn Kings make it to their tour stop after their car broke down in Wisconsin. Matt Gutman reports.

item.title: Bezos, Leonardo DiCaprio set up $200 million wildlife fund to save species on brink of extinction
item.description: Hollywood actor Leonardo DiCaprio and Amazon founder Jeff Bezos have announced a $200 million fund set to protect species on the brink of extinction. Carter Evans has the story.

item.title: State Department revokes visa of Brazil's ambassador to the U.S.
item.description: A senior State Department official said the visa would be reinstated immediately if Brazil grants diplomatic approval for President Trump's nominee for U.S. ambassador to Brazil, Daniel Perez.

item.title: Virginia's 2nd District to see rematch between Kiggans, Luria
item.description: Democrat Elaine Luria, who previously served four years in Congress, lost to Republican Rep. Jennifer Kiggans in 2022.

item.title: Shannon Taylor wins Democratic primary in Virginia's 1st District
item.description: Virginia Democrats are refocusing on a handful of GOP-held seats in Virginia after the state Supreme Court struck down a redrawn congressional map that favored Democrats in all but one district.

item.title: Man dies in ICE custody at Delaney Hall in New Jersey, DHS says
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security has confirmed the death of a detainee at a controversial immigration center in New Jersey. CBS News' Camilo Montoya-Galvez reports.

item.title: Breaking down the race between El-Sayed and Stevens for Michigan's Democratic Senate primary
item.description: Michigan Democrats Abdul El-Sayed and Haley Stevens are facing off in a key Senate primary on Tuesday. Ed O'Keefe has the details.

item.title: Chipotle removes jalapeños linked to Minnesota salmonella outbreak
item.description: The restaurant chain said it pulled the peppers and replaced them with product from another grower amid a food-poisoning probe.

item.title: Salmonella outbreak possibly linked to Chipotle jalapeños under investigation in Minnesota
item.description: At least 110 people have fallen ill from salmonella in Minnesota, the vast majority of whom reported having eaten at the Mexican chain Chipotle. Tom Hanson has the story.

item.title: Idaho In-N-Out shooting victims remembered by loved ones: "She lit up a room"
item.description: Three people were killed and seven others were wounded in the Saturday attack in Twin Falls, Idaho. The gunman died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound, officials said.

item.title: 8/4: CBS Evening News
item.description: Police arrest arson suspect in Spokane fires; Chipotle suspected in salmonella outbreak.

item.title: Wayward SpaceX rocket to slam into moon, leave 16-foot-deep crater
item.description: The impact will not be visible to the naked eye, but photos are expected to come from a lunar satellite at a later time.

item.title: 8/3: CBS Evening News
item.description: Spokane wildfires force thousands to evacuate; Michigan reports two cyclosporiasis deaths.

item.title: 8/2: CBS Weekend News
item.description: Mass evacuations underway as wildfires bear down on Spokane, Washington; New details on deadly In-N-Out shooting.

item.title: 8/1: CBS Weekend News
item.description: President Trump criticizes decision to drop charges in Reflecting Pool case; Tensions rise in the Middle East.

item.title: Aiden Fisher on Indiana University's epic turnaround
item.description: Former Indiana University linebacker Aiden Fisher credits head coach Curt Cignetti for Indiana University's success, citing his savvy recruitment of players — often from outside of college football's top teams — to build a roster of hard-working underdogs.

item.title: Roman Colosseum reopens with new views
item.description: A new expansion of the famed Roman Colosseum gives tourists the opportunity to see the famed venue in a new light. Seth Doane reports.
